attributes.title: Codex CLI — Tool Results
attributes.description: Tool-result events (labels.event_name: codex.tool_result) for the codex-cli agent — tool name / origin / mcp flag / success / duration plus argument & output sizes. Filtered on labels.event_name, Codex's event-type field (NOT claude's message). Documented departure from the claude convention: NO user_email lead — these trace_safe-family docs carry no identity envelope (user_email rides the log_only twin; the joined ES|QL view restores it). Constraint shown as a filter pill. Built on the Codex CLI — Events data view.

attributes.title: Codex CLI — Event Overview
attributes.description: All Codex CLI event types interleaved by @timestamp — the cross-event-type timeline the per-event_name searches are filtered slices of. Two filter pills: service.framework.name: codex_cli_rs scopes to the trace_safe family (the docs that carry labels.event_name), and a negated NOT labels.event_name: codex.websocket_event drops the per-streamed-event wrappers (stream noise, ~894/session). labels.event_name is a visible column (the 'what'). Per the Codex convention: NO user_email lead — trace_safe-family docs carry no identity envelope (it rides the log_only twin). Built on the Codex CLI — Events data view.

attributes.title: Codex CLI — Tool I/O (joined)
attributes.description: The repo's first Codex ES|QL-based saved Discover session — one row per tool call (who + tool + input + output) by joining Codex's two log families on labels.call_id within logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs*: the trace_safe codex.tool_result doc (tool_name/success/duration_ms/sizes/trace.id) with its log_only twin (user_email + arguments command + output stdout). No data view / filter pills (an ES|QL query). The log_only family emits a null-content start doc plus a populated completion doc per call; VALUES() drops the nulls so STATS BY labels.call_id collapses both twins and the trace_safe doc into one clean, single-valued row. ts = MAX(@timestamp) is the tool-finished time. Columns: ts, user_email, tool, input, output, success, duration_ms, trace_id. Codex tool content is on by default (no extra gate); arguments/output are content-bearing.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query": {"esql": "FROM logs-apm.app.codex_cli_rs* | WHERE labels.call_id IS NOT NULL | STATS ts = MAX(@timestamp), user_email = VALUES(labels.user_email), tool = VALUES(labels.tool_name), input = VALUES(labels.arguments), output = VALUES(labels.output), success = VALUES(labels.success), duration_ms = VALUES(labels.duration_ms), trace_id = VALUES(trace.id) BY labels.call_id | KEEP ts, user_email, tool, input, output, success, duration_ms, trace_id | SORT ts DESC"}, "filter": []}
